author: Nintendo of America
description:
Persona 4 Revival goes on air May 20, 2027 on Nintendo Switch 2!

In Persona 4 Revival, legend has it that a mysterious broadcast known as the "Midnight Channel" appears only on rainy nights. The day after it airs, a corpse is found in Inaba, a quiet and peaceful town in rural Japan suddenly thrown into turmoil. To uncover the truth behind these chilling mysteries, you and your friends form an investigation team to unravel the secrets of the Midnight Channel and the bizarre murders. As your adventure unfolds, you face off against "Shadows," eerie manifestations of individuals' darker selves. Together, you awaken a hidden power called "Persona" and embark on a journey to prevent more tragedies while uncovering the truth behind the chaos.
 
#NintendoDirect #Persona4Revival

Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United arrives February 16, 2027 on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch! Wishlist today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/romancing-saga-3-destinies-united-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United brings the 1995 RPG classic back as a full 3D remake, combining the series’ signature free-form storytelling with modern graphics and quality-of-life features.

Players choose from 8 unique protagonists and set out on a highly flexible adventure. Decisions shape the journey and quests can be tackled in the order you choose as the Four Sinistrals threaten the end of the world.
 
Featuring fully reconstructed towns and dungeons, redesigned characters, full voice acting for event scenes, and newly arranged music supervised by original composer Kenji Ito, the remake offers a fresh yet faithful way to experience one of the SaGa franchise’s defining entries.

author: Nintendo of America
description:
METAL SLUG ULTIMATE COLLECTION comes to Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch in 2027.
 
The side-scrolling action series METAL SLUG is back with 10 titles!

Enjoy online multiplayer with players around the world, challenge others through online rankings, and relive the series with an expanded collection of classic content.
 
Explore the gallery—featuring a wealth of artwork and music from across the series—and take on the enhanced Combat School Mode, where you'll complete missions while interacting with your instructors.
 
For the first time ever, the elusive location test version of the original METAL SLUG—once thought to be lost to history—will be officially included, over 30 years after its debut!

Eternal Anima comes to Nintendo Switch 2 on March 4, 2027!

Experience a dramatic time-travel adventure that spans generations in this legacy-driven JRPG! In a world that erased its own history, you'll have to chart a course into the past, forge uneasy alliances, take down grand enemies, and alter the course of catastrophic events. Use unique abilities like Psychometry to inherit ancestral abilities lost to time, and Future Sight to manipulate the field of battle. Can you save the past and free the present?
